note: questions T15 cannot answer from the recordings. Each carries its own evidence pointer and is left open; nothing downstream should treat an unanswered entry as decided.

questions.question: what does each numeric valueTypeValue mean, and is the historical 推断 table correct for the 7.1 build?
questions.recordedFacts: the live read carries both a numeric code and, for some codes, a name ('Generics'=10000, 'List'=10002, and codes 1/2/4/5/6/7/10003 equal their own name)
questions.whatIsMissing: no recording maps the numeric codes to Chinese type names for the 7.1 build

questions.question: which concrete types may bind to a Generics pin, and is that binding recorded anywhere?
questions.recordedFacts: 829 pin records across 929 variants carry valueTypeName 'Generics'
questions.whatIsMissing: no binding constraint is recorded; the contract marks genericBinding unknown

questions.question: what is the element type of a List pin?
questions.whatIsMissing: no element type is recorded; the contract marks elementType unknown

questions.question: which official graph type does each of these kinds correspond to?
questions.recordedFacts: the official taxonomy names 9 graph types; the recordings carry 4 category kinds
questions.whatIsMissing: no recording maps one list onto the other; sides are recorded as the project's own classification only

questions.question: which modes (if any) change a node's port set?
questions.recordedFacts: for all 119 definitions carrying more than one category variant, the pin set is identical across those variants
questions.whatIsMissing: no recording carries a mode for a node definition or a category variant

questions.question: what is the resource field-107 message, and why does the live read not report it as a pin?
questions.recordedFacts: 31 definitions carry such a message; the decoder ignores its sub-fields 1 and 103
